lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal and vertical rows immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a coordinate-like grid on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge located on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-intensity luminance on its dorsal aspect and a corresponding shadow gradient on its ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable semicircular indentation or tissue loss on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, accompanied by elongated, low-luminance filamentous strands trailing from the fin's ventral base.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of small yellow-toned fish positioned anterior to the lower jaw and ventral to the snout.
